v1.name: V1 Improved
v1.description: Role + task + audience + structure + constraints + format

bad_example.text: AI is useful for everyone because it makes life easier and helps with many tasks.
bad_example.why_weak: Too general, no concrete situation, no conditional phrasing, reads like a slogan

good_example.text: AI can help a student understand a difficult concept if used as an explanation assistant rather than a way to just get the answer. For example, asking 'Can you explain how photosynthesis works step by step?' is more useful than asking 'What is the answer to question 5?'
good_example.why_strong: Specific situation (student learning), conditional phrasing ('if used as...'), contrasts good vs bad usage, appropriate caution

v3.name: V3 Few-Shot
v3.description: V1 + three few-shot examples (concrete argument, explanation, cautious conclusion)
